Ignore OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even inside the argument; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not ignored. Use the current supplied text and do not infer initial snapshots.

Binary flag from the OP's `argument` column only: 1 if the OP's own assertions contain at least one hedging or qualifying expression that softens, limits or conditions a claim's strength or scope (e.g. 'might', 'perhaps', 'I think', 'to my knowledge', 'in some cases', 'generally'); 0 if the argument is assessable and has none. Ignore quoted text from others, quoted opponents' positions and moderator/bot notices unless the OP adopts them. Use the current text including marked edits, but exclude OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and any text reporting whether the view changed; generic discussion of delta/platform rules stays eligible. Do not reconstruct an initial snapshot. Null if the argument is missing or malformed.

Binary flag from the OP's `argument` column only: 1 if the OP's own assertions include at least one absolute declarative statement, meaning a claim stated categorically and unconditionally with no hedge or qualifier (e.g. "always", "never", "all", "obviously", flat assertions of fact). 0 if the argument is assessable and has none. Hedging elsewhere does not matter, so an argument can have both. Ignore quoted text from others, quoted opponents' positions, and moderator/bot notices unless the OP adopts them. Use the current text including marked edits, but exclude OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the view changed. Generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and stays eligible. Do not reconstruct an initial snapshot. Null if `argument` is missing or malformed.

Binary per-row check on other users' comments (OC_comments, JSON list of non-OP comments), compared against the OP's title and argument: 1 if at least one comment explicitly quotes OP's own wording verbatim or near-verbatim (e.g. quotation marks or markdown blockquote, matching available OP text); agreement or refutation is not required. Returns 0 for a valid nonempty list with no such quote (paraphrase, summary, topic mention, or quoting other users, external sources or non-OP text doesn't count) and 0 for a valid empty list. Returns null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if title/argument is missing so a negative can't be established (a clear positive match to available OP text still gives 1). Ignore as evidence any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thanks/resolution updates or outcome reports, in argument or quoted in comments; generic delta/platform-rule discussion may be used. Uses current text only, no chronology inference; comment order is irrelevant.

Binary per-row: reads OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP), with title and argument only as context for the OP's stated emotional experience. Returns 1 if at least one single comment explicitly acknowledges or validates the OP's emotional experience (e.g., feelings understandable, valid, legitimate) and that validation appears earlier in the same comment than that comment's logical rebuttal/counter-argument to the OP's view; both must be in the same comment, and separate comments don't combine. Returns 0 if comments exist but none qualify (validation only after rebuttal, no rebuttal, or only non-emotional agreement such as agreeing with facts). Empty comment list gives 0; missing or malformed OC_comments gives null. Ignores quotations of others' positions the commenter doesn't adopt, and moderator/bot notices. Excludes OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and text reporting whether the outcome occurred (even in the argument); generic delta/platform-rule discussion is not excluded. Uses current text only, with no inference of initial snapshots or comment order across the list.

Binary per-row measure from OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP): 1 if at least one comment itself draws an analogy, comparing the issue under debate to a different, familiar, everyday or commonly understood scenario (common situation, activity, well-known comparison) to make its point; 0 if the list is valid and no comment does (literal discussion of the topic, or merely citing real examples of the same issue, is not an analogy). Quoted OP text alone doesn't count; the analogy must be the commenter's own argument. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution text, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic delta/platform-rule discussion is neither an announcement nor an analogy by itself. Uses current text, no timing inferred. Empty list gives 0; missing or malformed input gives null.

Binary flag from the OP title only (column: title), ignoring any "CMV:" prefix and any outcome text such as view change or delta: 1 if the title explicitly contains an absolute universal quantifier word or phrase that quantifies its claim (e.g., all, every, always, never, none, no one, nobody, everyone; examples, not exhaustive), else 0. Missing or empty title returns null. No argument, comments or outcome information is used.

Binary flag from the OP title only (column: title): 1 if the title explicitly contains a variable, non-absolute or probabilistic quantifier/hedge word or phrase (e.g., some, many, most, often, usually, generally, sometimes, rarely, may, might, can, likely, probably, tend to; examples, not exhaustive), else 0. Ignore the "CMV:" prefix; may also be 1 on an absolute-quantifier measure (overlap not resolved). Don't use the argument, comments or outcome info (view change, delta), which would be excluded. Missing or empty title returns null.

Binary check on OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP; only this column used): 1 if at least one comment explicitly cites a specific, concrete real-world example as part of its counter-argument, e.g. a named or particular actual case, event, person, institution, study, statistic tied to a case, or concrete personal experience; otherwise 0. Abstract principles, generic claims, and invented or hypothetical scenarios do not count; quoting the OP alone does not count. Ignore text that is an OP view-change or delta-award announcement, a post-outcome thank-you or resolution update, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic delta or platform-rule discussion stays eligible but counts only if it cites a specific instance. Any comment qualifying suffices; list order is irrelevant. A valid empty list returns 0; missing or malformed OC_comments returns null.

Binary flag from OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP; parse it; order irrelevant): 1 if at least one comment itself offers specific empirical evidence supporting its counter-argument, i.e. concrete data, statistics, study/research findings, documented real-world cases or specific factual observations (a specific personal experience can count). 0 if comments are assessable but none have such evidence (purely abstract/logical reasoning, opinion, generic unsupported factual assertions, or vague appeals without specifics). Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is neither evidence nor excluded. Empty list -> 0; missing or malformed input -> null.

Binary flag from OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP; parse it): 1 if at least one comment offers a logical refutation of the OP's view (argument from reasoning, logic, consistency, or definitions) AND no comment contains specific empirical evidence (concrete data, statistics, studies, documented real-world cases, or specific factual observations, including specific personal experience). 0 if any comment contains such empirical evidence, or if no comment offers a logical refutation; empty list -> 0. Missing or malformed input -> null. Comment order is irrelevant. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules counts neither as evidence nor is excluded.

Binary: 1 if at least one single comment by other users (OC_comments, a JSON list parsed first; title and argument serve only as OP context to identify components) first explicitly acknowledges that a specific component (particular claim, premise or point) of the OP's argument is valid/correct/reasonable, and then, later in that same comment, gives a counter-example (a specific case or instance countering the OP's view or claim). Acknowledgment and counter-example must be in one comment; separate comments don't combine. Generic politeness, vague agreement, whole-OP acknowledgment, counter-argument without a specific example, or quotation marks alone don't count. Judge only comment text; ignore view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thanks/resolution updates or outcome reports (generic delta/platform rule discussion is not excluded); use current text including marked edits. Output 0 if the list is valid but no comment qualifies, including an empty list; null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or OP context is missing so the targeted component can't be determined.

Binary per-row flag from OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP): 1 if at least one comment, in the commenter's own words, uses second-person direct address to the OP/reader (you, your, or imperatives addressed to them); 0 if the list is valid and no comment does. Quoted text from the OP or others doesn't count unless the commenter adopts it as their own address; generic "you"-free analysis doesn't count. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution text, and outcome reporting; generic discussion of delta/platform rules counts only if it directly addresses the OP. Valid empty list -> 0; missing or malformed list -> null.

Binary row-level flag from OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP): 1 if at least one comment's argument relies on third-person analysis, i.e. analyzes the topic, people, groups, events or cases in third person (he/she/they/it/impersonal) rather than addressing the OP/reader directly. A comment mixing in some direct address counts only if its main argumentative content is third-person analysis. Returns 0 if the list is valid and no comment qualifies, including a valid empty list; null if the list is missing or malformed. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates or outcome reports; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement.

Binary per-row measure from the OP's "argument" text only (current supplied text, including marked edits; edits not removed, no timing inferred): 1 if the OP, in their own voice, recounts at least one direct personal anecdote, meaning a specific experience, event or situation they personally lived or directly witnessed (e.g., "when I worked at...", "my friend told me / happened to me"). 0 if the text has only abstract claims, general statistics, hypotheticals/invented scenarios, or other people's experiences or quotations not adopted as the OP's own direct experience; quotation marks alone neither make nor break an anecdote. Ignore view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the view changed (never evidence); generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an anecdote or outcome text by itself and may be retained if relevant. Returns null if the argument is missing or malformed.

Binary flag: 1 if at least one comment by a non-OP user (OC_comments, JSON list) explicitly states a specific, checkable real-world factual claim (e.g. statistic, historical event, study finding, law, documented case) that is distinct from facts already in the OP's title/argument (given as context); verification is not performed, judged from text. Opinions, value judgments, purely logical arguments, hypotheticals, and restatements or quotations of OP claims do not count. Returns 0 if the list is valid and no comment qualifies, including an empty list; null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or OP text is missing so distinctness can't be judged. Ignores OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and reports of whether the outcome occurred (even inside argument or comments); generic discussion of delta/platform rules remains eligible. Uses current text only, no reconstruction of snapshots or ordering.

Binary flag from the OP's argument column (current text, including marked edits only): 1 if the OP, in their own voice, explicitly acknowledges that alternative perspectives, viewpoints or interpretations to their own view exist (e.g., others may see it differently, other reasonable positions exist); 0 if no such explicit acknowledgment. Quoted or reported opponents' positions don't count unless the OP explicitly adopts them as acknowledged alternatives, and mere topic mentions don't count. Ignore OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and may count. Null if the argument is missing or malformed.

Binary judgment on the OP's own argument text (column "argument", current text including marked edits): 1 if, in the OP's own voice, the conclusion is framed as the only possible or inevitable one and alternative perspectives are neither acknowledged nor treated as legitimate; 0 otherwise, including when alternatives are explicitly acknowledged or the argument is merely confident or one-sided without framing the conclusion as the only possible one. Quoted or reported opponents' positions don't count as the OP's framing. Ignore OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting the outcome (generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and may be considered). Null if the argument is missing or malformed.

Share of other users' comments (OC_comments, a JSON list of counter-argument comments, parsed) that directly quote wording from the OP's title or argument (reference text, current supplied text including marked edits). A comment counts if it reproduces verbatim or near-verbatim OP wording, typically in quotation marks or block quote; endorsement or refutation not required. Not counted: quotes of other sources, paraphrases, topic mentions, or quotes matching only OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or outcome-reporting text (generic platform/delta-rule discussion remains eligible). Output is quoting comments divided by total comments, in [0,1]; 0 if none quote. Null if OC_comments is an empty list, malformed or missing; also null if OP title and argument are both missing, unless a match was positively established. List order is irrelevant.

Binary flag over OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP): 1 if at least one comment cites a specific, actual real-world example to support its counter-argument, i.e. a particular real event, case, person, organization, place, study/statistic/data point, or concrete personal experience; need not be institutional or public, nor externally verified. Output 0 if the list is valid and nonempty but no comment does so (purely abstract reasoning, generic claims, invented/hypothetical scenarios, or vague references without a specific actual case don't count). Empty list gives 0; missing or malformed input gives null. Ignore text that is an OP view-change or delta-award announcement, a post-outcome thank-you/resolution update, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not such an announcement and stays eligible. List order is irrelevant. Output 0, 1 or null.

Lexical density of other users' counter-argument comments (source column OC_comments, a JSON list): content words (nouns, main/lexical verbs, adjectives, adverbs) divided by all words (content plus function words like articles, prepositions, pronouns, conjunctions, auxiliaries, determiners), as a 0–1 number estimated carefully. Words are pooled across all comments in the row (not averaged per comment; order irrelevant). Excluded before counting: text reporting OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, text reporting whether the outcome occurred, moderator/bot notices, and URLs/markup; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is kept as ordinary text. Returns null if the list is valid but empty, has no words after exclusions, or OC_comments is missing or malformed.

Binary per-row check on OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by non-OP users; order meaningless): returns 1 if at least one comment itself cites a specific, localized example in support of its counter-argument, meaning a particular concrete case, instance, named or identifiable person, place, event, or specific personal experience (real or documented, need not be verified), rather than only general principles, abstract claims, broad statistics or generic hypotheticals. Returns 0 if the list is valid and no comment does so, including a valid empty list; null if OC_comments is missing or malformed. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and text reporting whether the outcome occurred as evidence; generic discussion of platform/delta rules is not itself a specific example.

Binary per-row flag from the `argument` column only (the OP's own explanation text): 1 if the OP's own current text contains at least one explicit hedging or self-doubt marker about their own claims or view (e.g., "I might be wrong", "I'm not sure", "to my knowledge", "I guess", "perhaps", admitting possible error or uncertainty); 0 if the argument is assessable and has no such explicit marker. Ignore hedges inside quotations or reported positions of others unless the OP adopts them. Exclude, and do not use as evidence, OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred (e.g., "EDIT: view changed", "Δ"); generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not outcome reporting and may be kept. Do not reconstruct an initial version. Output null if the argument is missing or malformed.

Binary: from OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP, parsed), returns 1 if at least one comment gives a concrete, locally verifiable example as its own support: a specific instance, case, data point, or personal experience with concrete particulars a reader could check or observe directly (not a general principle or invented hypothetical; external verification not required). Quoted text from others counts only if the commenter uses it as their own supporting example. Returns 0 if the list is non-empty but no comment qualifies, and 0 for an empty list; null if OC_comments is missing or malformed. List order is ignored. Excludes OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred (generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not excluded and stays eligible); delta is not used.

Binary flag from OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP; parsed): 1 if at least one comment's argument relies on abstract principles, meaning general normative, theoretical or conceptual reasoning not anchored in a specific concrete case; 0 if the list is non-empty and no comment does. A comment that also includes concrete examples still counts if abstract-principle reliance is present; list order is ignored. Empty list gives 0; missing or malformed OC_comments gives null. Exclude OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and stays eligible. Delta is not used.

Binary row measure from OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP): returns 1 if at least one comment contains a concrete real-world example offered in the commenter's own argument, i.e. a specific actual case, event, person, institution, statistic tied to a real case, or concrete personal experience; otherwise 0. Invented/hypothetical scenarios and purely abstract principles don't count; no outside verification needed; example lists are nonexhaustive. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic delta/platform-rule discussion is not an example or announcement; moderator/bot notices don't count; list order is irrelevant. A valid empty list or no qualifying comment gives 0; missing or malformed OC_comments gives null.

Binary per-row measure from OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP; parse it): returns 1 if the list is non-empty and every substantive comment relies solely on abstract logic/reasoning (general principles, definitions, conceptual or logical argument) with no concrete real-world example (specific actual case, event, person, institution or personal experience). Returns 0 if at least one comment contains a concrete real-world example, or any substantive comment relies on something other than abstract logic alone. Ignores OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, text reporting whether the outcome occurred, and moderator/bot notices; generic delta/platform rule discussion is not an announcement but also not a concrete example. List order is irrelevant. Returns null if the list is empty, missing or malformed.

Binary flag from the OP's own argument text only (column "argument", current text including marked edits): 1 if it contains at least one explicit conditional statement linking an outcome/consequence to a specific antecedent condition (if/then, unless, provided that, whenever, when X then Y); 0 if the argument is present but has none. Vague hedges without a stated antecedent-outcome link and mere questions don't count; quoted text attributed to others and not adopted by the OP doesn't count. Excluded from evidence: OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred (even inside the argument); generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and stays eligible. Missing or malformed argument returns null.

Binary: 1 if at least one comment in OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP) recounts, in the commenter's own text, a concrete personal anecdote (their own specific experience, or that of someone they personally know) illustrating real-world consequences of the OP's claim (consequences if the claim holds or is acted on). The claim is identified from title and argument (context only). Returns 0 if no comment does: only abstract/theoretical arguments, general facts, hypotheticals/invented scenarios, or others' quoted experiences not adopted by the commenter. Quoted OP text or quoted opponents' positions don't count. Ignore view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic delta/platform-rule discussion is neither an announcement nor an anecdote. Don't infer timing or order. Empty comment list -> 0; missing/malformed OC_comments, or missing title and argument so the claim can't be identified -> null.

Binary: 1 if at least one comment in OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP) rebuts or counters the OP's claim (from title and argument, which are context/target) primarily through abstract theoretical reasoning (general principles, theory, conceptual or logical argument) rather than concrete personal anecdote; 0 if no comment does. Quoted OP text or quoted opponents' positions don't count as the commenter's own reasoning. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, text reporting whether the outcome occurred, and generic delta/platform-rule discussion; don't infer timing or order. Empty comment list -> 0; missing/malformed OC_comments, or missing title and argument -> null.

Binary: from OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP), 1 if at least one comment itself cites a specific real-world example in support of its point: an actual concrete case, event, person, organization, place, study instance, or the commenter's concrete personal experience (nonexhaustive examples; external verification not required). Invented, hypothetical, generic scenarios and purely abstract claims don't count; quotations of others count only if used as a specific real-world example. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is neither such an announcement nor an example. Output 0 if the list is valid but no comment qualifies (including an empty list); null if OC_comments is missing or malformed.

Binary: 1 if at least one comment in OC_comments (JSON list of other users' comments, not the OP; parsed) presents a specific counterargument, i.e. concrete reasoning, evidence or an example targeting a particular claim or the position of the OP, not vague or generic disagreement. Title and argument are context only, used to identify the OP's claims. Output 0 if the list is valid and no comment qualifies; empty valid list gives 0; missing or malformed OC_comments gives null. List order is ignored. Moderator/bot notices don't count. Don't use as evidence any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even inside argument; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is allowed.

Share (0–1) of other users' comments that contain at least one explicit agreement marker, i.e. words expressly stating agreement with a point by the OP or another party (e.g. "I agree", "you're right", "fair point", "exactly"). Source: OC_comments (JSON list of other-user comments, parsed); output is marked comments divided by total comments, order ignored. Implicit agreement and mere politeness don't count; markers inside quoted text from someone else being rebutted don't count; moderator/bot notices are excluded. OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred are not evidence (generic delta/platform-rule discussion is allowed). Empty valid list or missing/malformed input gives null; 0 means no comment has a marker.

Binary per-row measure: whether at least one other-user comment in OC_comments (JSON list of non-OP comments) explicitly challenges an underlying assumption or premise the OP's reasoning rests on (e.g., questions a presupposed value, definition, or unstated premise, identified as something the OP assumes), rather than only disputing factual claims or the conclusion. Title and argument (OP's view) are context only, used to identify the target assumption, not as evidence. Comments that only rebut conclusions or facts, agree, or are off-topic don't count; exclude OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-yous/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred (generic delta/platform-rule discussion is not excluded). List order carries no chronology. Output 1 if any comment qualifies, 0 if OC_comments is a valid empty list or none qualify; null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if both title and argument are missing.

Binary per-row flag from the OP's own argument text only (not title, comments or conversation): 1 if the OP explicitly asks readers for restraint (e.g., don't downvote, be civil/polite, refrain from attacking or flaming) or for karma building (e.g., upvote or give karma to constructive/good-faith comments); otherwise 0. Ignore quoted text from others, moderator/bot notices, and generic mentions of subreddit or delta rules that are not an explicit request to readers. Do not use as evidence OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-yous/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred; marked edits are otherwise treated as current text, and timing is not inferred. Returns null if the argument is missing or malformed.

Binary flag (1/0) from the argument column only (the OP's own text): 1 if it contains an explicit first-person narrative of something that actually happened to or was done/lived by the OP (a specific event, episode, or period of their life). 0 if there is no such account: abstract reasoning, general claims, hypotheticals, invented scenarios, others' experiences, or merely stating an opinion or identity. Quoted or external text counts only if the OP adopts it as their own experience. Marked edits count as current text, but OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred are excluded and never count as evidence; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is neither positive nor excluded. Do not reconstruct an initial snapshot. Missing or malformed argument returns null.

Binary per-row flag from the "argument" column, using only the OP's own words (current text, including marked edits): 1 if the OP explicitly asks the community or readers for feedback, advice, input, opinions, responses, or critique (e.g. asks for advice, asks people to weigh in or share thoughts); 0 if there is no such explicit request, including when the OP only states a view or only uses the generic "change my view" framing. Ignore quoted text attributed to others. Do not use as evidence any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you or resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred. Generic discussion of platform or delta rules is not an outcome announcement and may count if relevant. An empty or missing argument gives null.

Binary per-row flag from the `argument` column only (the OP's explanation, current supplied text): 1 if the OP's own prose directly addresses the reader/audience in second person (you, your, yours, yourself, you're, or reader-directed imperatives like "consider..." or "imagine..."); otherwise 0. Generic "you" counts only if it actually addresses the reader (the spec's wording on generic "you" is garbled/ambiguous). "You" inside quoted text attributed to others, quoted opponents, or example dialogue does not count. Text with only impersonal, first-person or third-person phrasing gives 0. Excluded from consideration: OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred (including such edits); generic discussion of delta/platform rules stays eligible. Do not infer an initial snapshot or remove other edits. Missing or malformed argument gives null; an empty but valid string gives 0.

Binary per-row flag from OC_comments (JSON list of other users' counter-argument comments, not the OP): 1 if at least one comment itself uses a specific, concrete illustrative example to support its own counter-argument, i.e. a particular named or described case, instance, event, scenario or personal experience, real or hypothetical, not externally verified. Abstract principles and vague generic references ("many people", "some cases") don't count; a quoted passage from someone else counts only if the comment uses it as its own example. Ignore text reporting the OP's view change or delta award, post-outcome thanks/resolution updates, and whether the outcome occurred; generic delta/platform-rule discussion stays eligible but is not itself an example. Output 0 if the list is valid but no comment qualifies, including an empty list; null if OC_comments is missing or unparseable.

Counts comments in OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP) that contain at least one specific real-world example offered in the comment's own argument: an actual, concrete case such as a named or identifiable event, person, organization, policy, study, place, or the commenter's concrete personal experience (no outside verification needed). Invented or hypothetical scenarios, generic generalizations and vague references don't qualify; OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-yous/resolution updates and text reporting whether the outcome occurred never count as evidence, and generic delta/platform-rule discussion doesn't count unless itself a specific real-world case. Each comment counts at most once regardless of number of examples; counts comments, not distinct commenters. Output is an integer from 0 to list length; an empty valid list gives 0; missing or malformed OC_comments gives null.

Binary: 1 if at least one other-user comment in OC_comments (JSON list of non-OP comments, parsed as a list) directly quotes wording from the OP's title or argument (verbatim or near-verbatim reuse, typically in quotation marks or block-quote markup), checked against the supplied title/argument as context; the comment need not agree, disagree or refute. Paraphrase, mere topic mention, quotes of third-party sources or of other commenters do not count. Ignore OP view-change/delta announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and text reporting the outcome in the argument (neither quote source nor evidence; generic delta/platform rule discussion remains eligible); use current text, no reconstruction of initial snapshots. Output 0 if the list is valid but empty or no comment quotes OP text; null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if title and argument are both missing so a negative can't be established (a positive match to available OP text is still 1).

Binary per-row flag: 1 if at least one single other-user comment (parsed from the JSON list OC_comments) first explicitly states in words that the OP's view or a point of it is valid/correct/reasonable (partial agreement), and then, later in that same comment, introduces a narrower specific caveat, exception or qualification. title and argument are context only, used to identify the OP's target view. Both parts must be in one comment; separate comments don't combine. Bare politeness, a bare "but" without explicit acknowledgment, or a blanket rejection of the whole view don't count. Ignore OP text announcing a view change or delta award, post-outcome thank-yous/resolution updates, and text reporting the outcome; generic discussion of delta/platform rules stays eligible. Ignore comment text that merely quotes the OP as background. Output 0 if the list is valid but empty or no comment qualifies; null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or title/argument is missing so the target can't be determined. List order carries no meaning.

Binary per-post check on other users' comments (OC_comments, a JSON list to parse), judged against the OP's view from title and argument (context only). Returns 1 if at least one comment opens by directly contradicting or rejecting the OP's view as a whole, in general blanket disagreement not limited to a narrow part, without first explicitly acknowledging any validity in the OP's view. Returns 0 if the list is valid but empty, or no comment does this, including comments that acknowledge validity first or only raise narrow caveats. Ignores OP text announcing a view change or delta award, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules remains eligible. Returns null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if title or argument is missing so the target can't be determined. List order carries no chronology or rank.

Binary: 1 if at least one comment in OC_comments (JSON list of other users' comments, not the OP's) explicitly quotes (verbatim or near-verbatim, in quotation marks or block quote) or explicitly references a specific identifiable textual element of the OP's title/argument (a sentence, phrase, claim, example or passage, e.g. "you say that...", "your point about X"). Endorsement or refutation not required; merely discussing the general topic without pointing to specific OP text doesn't count. Title and argument are context for matching. Output 0 if the list is valid and no comment does so, or if it is a valid empty list; null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if a negative can't be established because title/argument is missing (a positive match against available OP text is still 1). Ignore as evidence any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates or text reporting the outcome, even in the argument; generic delta/platform-rule discussion remains eligible. Marked edits in current text are usable; list order carries no chronology or rank.

Binary: whether at least one comment in OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP) directly quotes wording from the OP's title or argument (reference text), verbatim or near-verbatim reproduced OP text, typically in quotation marks or block-quote formatting, matching available OP text. Endorsement or refutation not required (agree, disagree or merely reproduce). Output 1 if any comment does; 0 if the list is valid but empty or no comment quotes OP text. Paraphrase without reproduced wording, quotes of other sources/users, and quotations not matching OP text don't count. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-yous/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred, in argument or comments (neither quote source nor evidence); generic discussion of delta/platform rules remains eligible. Uses current supplied text including marked edits, subject to that exclusion. Null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if both OP title and argument are missing.

Binary: 1 if at least one other-user comment in OC_comments (JSON list, parsed) presents a substantive counterargument to the OP's view, meaning reasons, evidence or logic challenging the OP's position; the view is identified from OP context title and argument (context only, not measured text). Mere disagreement, insults, jokes, questions without argument, or agreement do not count. Returns 0 if the list is valid and no comment qualifies, and 0 for an empty valid list; null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if both OP title and argument are missing. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even inside argument or comments; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not such an announcement and stays eligible. List order is irrelevant.

Binary: whether every other-user comment supports or agrees with the OP's view, with none challenging it. Reads title and argument (OP context, used to identify the OP's view) and OC_comments (JSON list of other users' comments, parsed; order irrelevant). Outputs 1 if the list has at least one comment and all express support/agreement; 0 if any comment is not supportive (counterargument, disagreement, neutral, or off-topic). Null if the parsed list is empty, OC_comments is missing/malformed, or OP context is missing. Ignores OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even inside argument or comments; generic discussion of delta/platform rules remains eligible.

Binary: 1 if at least one comment in OC_comments (JSON list of other users' comments, parsed; title and argument are context only to identify the OP's view) makes a specific counter-argument to the OP's view AND, within that same comment, cites an empirical example: a concrete real-world case, documented instance, statistic/study finding, or specific personal experience offered as evidence (no outside verification needed, any type). Each comment is judged independently; list order is irrelevant. Purely abstract, logical, normative, or hypothetical/invented scenarios, and vague generic assertions without a specific example, don't qualify. Output 0 if the list is valid but no comment qualifies (including an empty list); null if OC_comments is missing or malformed. Ignore as evidence any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution text, or reports of whether the outcome occurred (even in argument or comments); generic discussion of delta/platform rules remains eligible. Use only current supplied text; don't infer initial snapshots or timing.

Binary per-row flag from the `argument` column only (the OP's own text; title not used): 1 if the OP, in their own voice, explicitly asks readers for emotional support (comfort, reassurance, encouragement) or for assistance/help (e.g. coping with or resolving a personal situation); otherwise 0. Returns 0 when there is no explicit request, including when the OP only asks to have their view challenged or changed in the standard CMV way, or only describes feelings without asking for support or help. Excludes quoted text from others, moderator/bot notices, OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred (even if thanking people or mentioning support); generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and may be considered. Uses the supplied current text including marked edits, with no initial snapshot reconstructed. Returns null if the argument is missing or malformed.

Binary flag from OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP; parsed): 1 if at least one comment introduces a concrete external factual analogy, meaning a specific actual real-world case, event, situation or comparison from outside the OP's own scenario, used as an analogy or parallel to the topic. A concrete personal experience may qualify, and the commenter need not endorse the analogy. Purely invented hypotheticals, abstract principles and pure logical reasoning without a concrete real-world case don't count. Returns 0 if the list is valid and either nonempty with no qualifying comment, or empty. Returns null if OC_comments is missing or malformed. List order is irrelevant. OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thanks or resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred are ignored as evidence; generic discussion of delta or platform rules is allowed if relevant. Judged from the supplied current text only.

Binary check on OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP; parse it; order irrelevant): returns 1 if every comment relies solely on abstract logical refutation of the OP's view (general reasoning, principles, definitions, logical structure) and no comment introduces a concrete external factual analogy or specific real-world case/example. Returns 0 if the list is nonempty and at least one comment introduces a concrete real-world analogy, case or example. Returns null if the list is empty, missing or malformed. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thanks/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred (generic delta/platform-rule discussion is allowed). Judge only from the supplied current text.

Word count (whitespace-separated tokens) of the current OP argument text, read only from the `argument` column (not title, comments or conversation). Marked edits and quotations are counted as current text, with no reconstruction of an initial snapshot. Excluded are OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred (e.g. "CMV changed, delta awarded", "thanks, you changed my view"). Generic discussion of delta or platform rules is not an announcement and stays counted. Output is a non-negative integer (0 for empty text); null if the argument is missing or malformed.

Binary per-row measure from the `argument` column only (the OP's current argument text, including marked edits): 1 if the OP, in their own voice, explicitly acknowledges potential counterpoints, objections, counterarguments or opposing views to their own position (e.g. noting what others might object, or conceding a possible opposing consideration); 0 if no such explicit acknowledgment appears. Does not count quotations or opponents' positions the OP doesn't raise or adopt as a possible counterpoint, nor generic uncertainty without reference to a counterpoint. Entirely excludes as evidence any view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the view changed (these must not produce a 1); generic discussion of platform/delta rules is not an outcome announcement and stays eligible if relevant. Does not reconstruct an initial post version. Returns null if the argument is missing or malformed.

Binary per-row measure from the `argument` column (OP's own text only, current supplied text including marked edits): 1 if the OP, in their own voice, discloses personal emotional vulnerability about themselves (own fear, shame, insecurity, sadness, distress, loneliness, emotional pain or struggle); otherwise 0. Does not count: purely intellectual, factual or general statements, other people's feelings, hypothetical or invented persons, quotations of others not adopted by the OP, or mere anger/opinion without self-exposing vulnerability. Ignore as evidence any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thanks or resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred (even if emotionally vulnerable); generic discussion of delta/platform rules may be kept if relevant. Do not reconstruct the original post. Missing or malformed argument returns null; assessable text with no qualifying disclosure returns 0.

Binary per-row flag from OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP): 1 if at least one comment itself offers specific empirical evidence for its own argument, i.e. concrete statistics/data, named studies or sources, documented real-world cases, or specific factual observations/personal experiences. General assertions, opinions, hypotheticals and invented scenarios don't count; outside verification isn't required; evidence merely quoted from the OP as the OP's position doesn't count. Ignore text announcing the OP's view change or delta award, post-outcome thanks/resolution updates, and reports of whether the outcome occurred; generic delta/platform-rule discussion is not an outcome announcement and not evidence. Output 0 if the list is valid but no comment qualifies (including empty list); null if OC_comments is missing or malformed.

Binary per-row judgment: 1 if at least one comment in OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP, parsed) presents a well-reasoned counterargument, i.e. directly challenges the OP's stated view with coherent, relevant, logically structured reasoning or evidence; 0 if the list is valid and no comment does so (including an empty list). OP title and argument are used only to identify the view being countered; comment order is ignored. Output null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if both OP title and argument are missing. Excludes any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred (even if embedded in the argument); generic delta/platform-rule discussion is allowed where relevant. The conversation column is not used.

Binary per-row flag from OC_comments (JSON list of other users' counter-argument comments, not the OP): 1 if at least one comment itself asserts or cites specific numerical data or statistics as part of its argument (concrete figures, percentages, rates, counts, dates-as-quantities, numeric study results; need not be verified or externally sourced), else 0. Incidental numbers not used as data (list numbering, "two reasons") and purely general/qualitative claims don't count; generic delta/platform-rule discussion is retainable but counts only if it is itself numerical data used in argument. Ignore moderator/bot notices, and exclude OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-yous or resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred. Empty list gives 0; missing or malformed input gives null.
